explanation: The assembly of believers that Jesus founded, often understood as the Christian community or congregation.
Symbols of authority and power given to Peter to open the kingdom of heaven through preaching and discipline.
To declare something forbidden or invalid according to God's will, part of the spiritual authority of judgment.
To grant permission or freedom from sin and punishment, the opposite of binding, expressing God's grace through the church.
People who catch fish; in a metaphorical sense, those who are to "catch" souls for faith in Jesus.
The instrument on which Jesus was executed, symbolizing suffering, sacrifice, and the path disciples must follow after him.
The title Jesus uses for himself, referring to his divine nature and his role in the day of judgment according to the book of Daniel.
